design: Solid GPUI paths select existing R8 vector-mask residency and carry Coverage::Exact through GlyphRun, planner batching, CPU reference and D3D11/D3D12 renderers. The existing glyph shader receives ToneCurve::EXACT; shader code and GPU instance layout do not change.

texture_workload.comparison: Equivalent constant-color RGBA gradient. The repeated mask scene has no new uploads or rasterizations; switching to gradient removes the old mask entry.

validation.new_pixel_test: Translucent fill and dashed stroke, fractional placement, solid R8 mask versus same-color RGBA gradient; maximum error <=2 byte levels on reference, WARP and Radeon.
validation.new_coverage_case: Text/Exact/Text masks, 1:1 texel-to-device-pixel scale, <=1 byte error across tested backends.
validation.clippy: PASS Windows --lib --tests -D warnings across aqua, graph, media, gpu-ref, d3d11, d3d12.

known_limitation.description: Initial 1.5x scaled mixed-mask conformance case fails on Radeon and integrated D3D11, while WARP passes. A plain text-only case on unchanged 1faf00b reproduces the same first failure and error maxima. The shape-mask feature uses one-to-one device-space rasters; the final case covers that scale without changing tolerance.
known_limitation.status: Unfixed pre-existing glyph sampling discrepancy; reproduction and initial traces preserved in known-scaling-limitation/.

api_change: GlyphRun and low-level Glyphs pass constructors now specify Coverage; existing text callers select Text.
